records.failure_reason: The only pre-existing field spectrum matches invoice/PO/contract labels; a business plan carries none of them, so all 5 declared fields returned 0 proposals and the covering 0 % was invisible rather than reported.
affects: GAP: business-plan document type unsupported by any declared spectrum

records.failure_reason: The market-reference rule requires a parenthesised publication year, so reference lines published without a year (and the wrapped-URL lines) produce no proposal; 2 of 5 references on the source page were dropped.

The label+percent rule consumes only the first percentage line under a table row label, so in a 4-column revenue table it returns one cell per row and the other cells are only recovered by the separate ratio_block rule.

Steps ④ (independent-party re-execution) and ⑤ (publish status) were not performed by this mission: the framework forbids the author from signing its own gate, so the pilot stops at a partial report with a provisional author review.
